prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop web homepage composition for Fluidise, landscape 1536×1024, edge-to-edge crisp English UI, no browser/device frame. This is immediately AFTER the protected immersive hero, which is offscreen and must not be redesigned. Visitors choose an independent developer tool and copy its installation command.

Lead with an asymmetric discovery-and-installation composition, not a marketing split hero. A broad reading column holds two successive open tool presentations, each its task, identity, short purpose, native Get started link, and compact existing landscape-backed illustrative example. A distinct narrow installation desk sits alongside the COMPLETE sequence, containing BOTH commands, never changing with tool filters. “Install with Homebrew.”, “macOS”; “brew install Fluidise/homebrew-tap/fluidise-clint”; “brew install Fluidise/homebrew-tap/fluidise-relay”; each has a recognizable copy control and Installation options link. Source content: “Start with the job.”, “All tools”, “Released”, “In development”; “Validate commit messages”, “fluidise-clint”, “v1.0.0 Released”; “Manage Git hooks”, “fluidise-relay”, “v0.1.0 Released”. Examples labelled “Illustrative example”, not live execution. Begin “The contract behind the tools” at the bottom.

References contribute ONLY Nocturne’s matte charcoal palette, Instrument Sans, restrained mineral-blue priority and existing landscape/example character; replace their composition. Keep square technical surfaces. The dominant graphic gesture is one carefully composed engraved crosshatch field that defines the installation desk’s empty surround, with intersecting directions and progressive density, no strokes behind text or commands. No continuous page rails, tiny slash strips or rounded-card grid. Keep the existing four-icon compact bottom-centered dock: Explore, Install, Principles, GitHub, no top navbar. No invented commands, execution or performance claims.
purpose: Decision comp only; not a shipped asset or verified screenshot.
approval: The user selected Installation en regard on the decision page, confirmed its five-point brief, then explicitly requested implementation.
